items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know that Eric Kunzler did a record when Ellington was alive that had Ellington reciting these things

ctx.x: And Night Creature. Tell … actually before we get to, before I get to that, are these on any recordings?

They are on a recording, yes. There's something called the Symphonic Ellington. It's been done in different places. I'm not exactly sure. I know that Eric Kunzler did a record when Ellington was alive that had Ellington reciting these things and he did Harlem and he did, I think he did New World A-Coming.
That was Cincinnati Pops I believe.
